implementation_criteria: Canvas ID targeting remains at the unique label-relative same-row field position. A fresh screenshot must show the exact blank hint; CI-only egui diagnostics must prove the target field was enabled, clicked, focused, and empty. After placing the requested value on the system clipboard, retain a fresh no-op ArrowRight pressed-event observation and confirm the latest widget state remains enabled/focused/empty. Check refresh counts and receiver-busy state after clipboard setup; if a refresh started, completed, or remains busy, do not paste. When the gate passes, invoke paste immediately without another clipboard operation or await, and send Cmd+A/Cmd+V without an intervening delay. If focus or refresh stability is not proven, take a fresh screenshot and retry within the bounded attempt count, then fail closed. Preserve exact clipboard/visual readback and no-write gates.

C07.4 reopen accepts a no-prompt state only when the active view type is Bases, its full active file path matches one of the fixture-declared scenario paths, and its canonical active vault root matches the expected fixture vault. If a trust prompt is visible, explicitly select Restricted Mode and wait for that same exact restored-view predicate.
Existing C07.3, C07.4 scenario definitions, Canvas operations, vault snapshot gates, and source-integrity acceptance remain unchanged outside these harness corrections.
No local tests, builds, typechecks, formatters, validators, application launches, or runtime probes are run.
